Application Data.NAME: Johnson Auto Supplies
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Johnson Auto Supplies specializes in retailing a wide range of auto parts and accessories, including batteries, tires, brake systems, and performance upgrades. Our operations focus on providing high-quality products and exceptional customer service to both individual consumers and local automotive businesses. We also offer installation services for select items and provide expert advice to our customers regarding automotive repairs and upgrades. Our goal is to be a one-stop shop for all automotive needs in the Springfield area.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 15, 2023, a customer accidentally damaged a tire display while trying to reach for a specific product, resulting in a $1,200 loss. The incident was promptly reported and the claim is currently in the process of being settled with the insurance company.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, 2-Hour Fire Rating
